question: In the NO inhibition assay of the niaouli oil residue fractions, what IC50 does the heavy fraction (HF) have, and what NO inhibition (%) does it reach at a concentration of 200?
rendered:
The heavy fraction (HF) is mentioned in the document "Novel Alkali Extraction-Acid Precipitation-Chlorination Distillation Method for Co-extraction of Humic Substances and Germanium (Ge) from Ge-Rich Lignite". However, the NO inhibition assay data for the HF is actually found in the document "Green enrichment of α-terpineol from niaouli oil residue via molecular distillation".

Table 6 in the document "Green enrichment of α-terpineol from niaouli oil residue via molecular distillation" shows the NO inhibition (%) and IC50 (mg/mL) of test samples. For the HF, the IC50 is 161.23 ± 3.10 mg/mL, and the NO inhibition (%) at a concentration of 200 mg/mL is 57.49%.
